text:
claire: reserving maint slot ms-1102 for id-schema swap across hot shards. start 2026-09-07T02:00:00Z window=55m. plan: leader-only DDL, then phased backfill (4 waves) with progressive rate ramp. pin runtime to v2.18.1 for window.

deploybot: slot ms-1102 created. start=2026-09-07T02:00:00Z window=55m owner=@claire holdpoints=[smoke-pass, canary-verify] autopause=10m

omar: preflight items: staging smoke, run schema-compat tests, sample `pg_locks`, confirm read-replica health. canary tenants = s-small-11/12, initial rate=300/s, workers=3.

zhen: abort criteria I want in the thread: replication lag > 45s sustained 4m OR any deadlock > 1 OR table-locks > 6s on >=2 hosts. Also prefer to reduce batch size if CPU > 70% across writers.

claire: short rollback snippets for ops quick-run:
```
# stop waves
./scripts/migctl stop --slot ms-1102
# block writes
ffctl set tenant_id_swap_block true
# unpin runtime (fallback)
infractl pin api v2.17.4
# run revert DDL
psql -f revert/ms-1102-undo.sql
# post message
/msg #oncall "ms-1102 abort: executed revert DDL"
```

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-1102.smoke-pass. awaiting ACK from @omar and @zhen. react :white_check_mark: to proceed.

omar: smoke results: staging migration ok, pg_locks sample avg <1s, schematest passed. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary wave started (wave=1/5) targets=[s-small-11,s-small-12] workers=3 rate=300

zhen: watching replication & locks. I want `pg_stat_activity` snapshots every 20s during canary. If unpin blocks later, fallback is to flip route to read-fallback and scale read replicas +1 for 6m.

claire: added canary holdpoint ms-1102.canary-verify after wave completion. deploybot will pause for votes.

deploybot: canary complete. metrics: errors=0.03% replication_peak=26s p99 latency +2ms. next: CONTINUE or ABORT.

omar: +1 to continue. keep holdpoint open for 10m observation.

zhen: continuing but enable stricter lock watch. If table-lock >4s on >1 host we throttle batches.

claire: ramp plan for waves: 300/s -> 600/s -> 900/s -> 1200/s. We'll cap CPU and drop back to previous rate if contention observed.

deploybot: wave=2/5 started. workers=5 rate=600 queued=10

omar: noticed a 7s lock on shard-3 during wave 2, exceeding zhen's softer watch; lowering next wave batch size now.

zhen: instructing to decrease next wave to 450/s. also issuing quick terminate for long-running backfill queries if qtime > 40s:
```
psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'backfill' AND state='active' AND now()-query_start > interval '40 seconds'"
```

claire: executing rate change and capturing `pg_locks` snapshots to s3://redwood-runs/ms-1102/artifacts/

deploybot: wave=3/5 started with adjusted rate=450 workers=6

omar: replication peeked 51s during wave 3 on replica-2, pushing close to abort. recommend throttling and 5m observation window.

zhen: I agree — pause after wave 3 for 5m. if replication crosses 60s during that hold we abort and run rollback steps. otherwise resume with conservative rate.

claire: pausing now. will annotate release notes: runtime pinned v2.18.1, rollback commands in ops-runbook, artifacts path.

deploybot: holdpoint ms-1102.canary-verify engaged. awaiting votes.

omar: +1 continue after 5m watch if metrics stable. :white_check_mark:

zhen: holding final decision — will ABORT if any deadlock repeats. currently monitoring.

claire: thanks team. will collect post-run logs and open follow-up for batch tuning. will close thread after slot ends. :white_check_mark:
